# Clariti

> Clariti, made by Zapx Labs, reads confusing health paperwork — medical bills, insurance EOBs, lab results, radiology reports, discharge summaries, medication lists and letters — explains it in plain language, and helps you work out what to ask next.

Attach a document, take a photo, or paste the text, and Clariti explains one document at a time. The first 3 analyses are free; Clariti Plus removes the limit. It runs on the web, Android and iPhone. It explains paperwork; it does not diagnose, and it does not replace advice from your doctor, pharmacist or insurer.

## What it explains

- Medical bills: charges, odd fees, and what to ask next.
- Insurance EOBs: what was billed, covered, and left to you.
- Radiology reports: findings, anatomy words, and questions for your doctor.
- Lab results: markers, ranges, and what to ask next.
- Discharge summaries: why you were there, medications, and follow-up.
- Medication lists: names, doses, and questions for the pharmacist.

## Free tools

- [EOB decoder](https://useclariti.app/tools/eob-decoder): Enter the billed, allowed, plan-paid, deductible, copay, coinsurance and not-covered figures from one EOB line to see what each means, what you may owe (deductible + copay + coinsurance + not covered), whether the figures add up, and whether the provider's bill matches — with pointers to balance billing and the No Surprises Act (CMS). Runs in the browser; no sign-up, no AI, nothing sent.
